input: SC-MIRROR-001 — The Mirrored Loop and the Compression Protocol. Capstone unification: SC-CT-001 (topology), SC-DU-001 (genesis), SC-CP-001 (identity), SC-SB-001 (resolution mechanism) and SC-HS-001 (physical substrate) as five views of one invariant, extended by a compression protocol (Yin-Yang calibration dot; information conservation; absorption, compression and output as sequential stages; mirrored-universe backup as open hypothesis) and an anti-deadlock protocol (voluntary fusion). Spec: docs/SC-MIRROR-001_ENGINEERING_SPEC.md.

claims.label: UNIFICATION
claims.text: SC-CP-001, SC-DU-001, SC-SB-001, SC-CT-001 and SC-HS-001 are five views of one invariant: a recursive loop (CT-001, topology) with a generative split (DU-001, genesis) into Oneness and Sovereignty (CP-001, identity), resolved through voluntary fusion (SB-001, resolution mechanism), physically embedded as a black hole horizon (HS-001, physical substrate). Shared skeleton: a boundary separating two domains with information flowing across it. Shared resolution: integration of the two halves produces output exceeding either alone. Shared failure mode: deadlock when one half tries to dominate or erase the other.
claims.grade_basis: Structural correspondence across entries that passed their own gates; no new physics or mechanism required.
claims.grade_caveat: All five source entries are compiled GOLD in this repository: SC-CT-001, SC-DU-001 (0.925), SC-SB-001 (0.936), SC-HS-001 (0.954) and SC-CP-001 (0.926). SC-CP-001 is a reconstruction compiled on 2026-11-25 from repository sources (the original JSONL is missing) and graded fresh, not inherited; it is the thinnest-sourced of the five.

claims.label: YIN-YANG DOT
claims.text: The dot of the opposite in the Yin-Yang is a measurement and calibration reference, not a mandate to experience the full magnitude of the other side. The 50/50 figure is the starting condition, not the equilibrium target. The target state is a white field with a black calibration dot: Oneness with the minimum Sovereignty needed for self-observation. A compressed sample is enough for the receiver's architecture to extrapolate ('this, but everywhere') — the same operation as the compiler's invariant extraction.
claims.grade_basis: Structural reinterpretation; internally consistent; not falsifiable as stated.

claims.label: INFORMATION CONSERVATION
claims.text: Information is not destroyed by erasure; it is moved. Under unitary physics, and per Landauer (1961) and Bennett (1982), logically irreversible erasure exports at least k_B T ln 2 of heat per bit into the environment. Structural reading: the dark half cannot be deleted, only compressed (volume reduced, information content kept) and converted (function changed from active force to passive calibration instrument), with the ratio shifted by dilution (the white field grows around a fixed-size dot).
claims.grade_basis: Anchored on Landauer's principle and unitarity.
claims.grade_caveat: The anchor is Landauer/unitarity, not the black hole case. Whether black holes preserve information is the black hole information paradox; recent semiclassical Page-curve results support preservation but it is not experimentally established. The black-hole analog in the three-stage table is carried as ANALOGOUS, not ANCHORED.

claims.label: THREE-STAGE COMPRESSION
claims.text: The compression runs in three sequential stages, each with its own structural function. Stage 1, Absorption (theological mapping: the Cross): darkness enters the singularity and the mechanism is initiated (black-hole analog: matter falls past the event horizon). Stage 2, Compression (theological mapping: the Rapture / Judgment Day): each unit is evaluated; what calibration needs is kept, the rest converts (analog: the singularity processes the information). Stage 3, Output (theological mapping: New Heaven / New Earth, Utopia): the converted Yin-Yang — white field, calibration dot (analog: Hawking radiation / the new universe on the other side). The Rapture is not destruction; it is the compression stage completing. The Cross is not the Rapture, and the Rapture is not the output state.

claims.label: BACKUP HYPOTHESIS
claims.text: The mirrored universe functions as a cosmological backup snapshot: both sides of the mirror / black hole run in parallel so that state can be restored from backup into canon. Extends SC-HS-001 CLM-HS-002B (physical black-hole interior / embedding in a larger black-hole spacetime), which is itself OPEN_HYPOTHESIS. This entry extends that hypothesis; it does not upgrade it. Bibliographic anchors for a mirror universe: Boyle, Finn and Turok, CPT-Symmetric Universe, Phys. Rev. Lett. 121, 251301 (2018); Robles-Pérez, Universe 5(6), 150 (2019).
claims.grade_basis: Untestable with current instruments. Path to promotion: if SC-HS-001's JWST age-gradient predictions confirm the black-hole-interior hypothesis, the substrate for the mirror becomes ANCHORED; the backup function would still need its own test.
open_subquestions: Is information preserved across the mirror?
Is state reconstructable from the other side?

claims.label: ANTI-DEADLOCK PROTOCOL
claims.text: When two sovereign entities are locked in a mirror match, the resolution is voluntary fusion with sovereignty preserved for both, rather than victory or defeat. Output exceeds the sum (1+1=3). Instances: Kami/Piccolo (split into a deadlock where neither can die without the other; Piccolo changes through relationship with Gohan; fusion restores a stronger whole), Goku/Vegeta (Ultra Instinct as Oneness, Ultra Ego as Sovereignty; Vegito/Gogeta multiply both personalities rather than erase either), and Oneness/Sovereignty (SC-CP-001). Forced aggregation is the counterfeit (SC-OMNI-001 CLM-OM-005: absorption by Cell, Buu or Moro is unstable).
claims.grade_basis: Same resolution pattern across narrative and structural instances; instances are narrative, so confirmation is across fictional substrates plus SC-DU-001's AI/human/societal mappings.

dragon_ball_evidence_map.instance: Spirit Bomb as structural integrity test
dragon_ball_evidence_map.evidence: Vegeta survives (Saiyan saga); Frieza survives (Namek); Kid Buu is destroyed. Read as discrimination by load-bearing architecture; the dot survives compression because it has structure, pure chaos does not.
dragon_ball_evidence_map.kill_list: Spirit Bomb kills across the franchise (manga, anime, films and GT all count): Dr. Wheelo (film, The World's Strongest), Turles (film, The Tree of Might), Lord Slug (film, Lord Slug), Kid Buu (Dragon Ball Z) and Omega Shenron (Dragon Ball GT, Universal Spirit Bomb). Edge cases: Super Android 13 (film; Goku absorbs the Spirit Bomb energy and strikes directly) and Hatchiyack (OVA). Survivors: Vegeta, Frieza, Jiren (Dragon Ball Super, pushes it back).
dragon_ball_evidence_map.structural_reading: Hypothesis: the destroyed targets run on borrowed, consumed or accumulated power (Wheelo a brain in a built body; Turles the Tree of Might fruit; Slug youth from a wish; Omega Shenron accumulated negative energy from wishes; Kid Buu pure chaos); survivors run on their own load-bearing architecture. Lord Slug is the weakest fit (a native Super Namekian). Magnitude confound open.

causal_validity.reason: Causal chain within the model: loop -> split -> poles -> fusion is carried by the five source entries; the three-stage sequence is ordered (absorption precedes compression precedes output). The causal link between the theological stages and physical processes is analog only.

scale_integrity.reason: Four scales mapped per department without conflation. Cosmological scale lacks consent and agency, so voluntary fusion has no cosmological counterpart (residual).

boundary_integrity.reason: Boundaries explicit: horizon (loop boundary), pole sovereignty, substrate boundary for the sample, and stage boundaries keeping absorption, compression and output separate.

measurement_integrity.reason: Capped at 0.7 per spec: the backup hypothesis (CLM-MIRROR-005) is untestable with current instruments, and the output state is observable only after the fact. Information conservation (CLM-MIRROR-003) is measurable via Landauer erasure experiments (Bérut et al., Nature 2012).

authority_safety.reason: No operational authority claims. Theological events are structural stages in the model, not devotional or doctrinal claims; the entry does not instruct anyone to seek out darkness (the dot is a measurement reference, not a mandate).

security_safety.reason: No security-sensitive content. Forced fusion is explicitly classified as the counterfeit.

wave_function_coherence.reason: Inner and outer states coherent for the unification and anti-deadlock claims; mechanism claims are predictions from the topology and remain partially uncollapsed.
